ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( RecordType.Name = "Grinding Media / GET", TEXT(StageName) <> "Closed Lost", ISCHANGED(StageName) && ( CASE( StageName, "Qualification",1, "Update Decision Makers",2, "Update Account Plan",3, "Develop Tech and Comm proposal",4, "Present Proposal",5, "Negotiation/Review",6, "Closed Won",7, 0) - CASE(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Qualification",1, "Update Decision Makers",2, "Update Account Plan",3, "Develop Tech and Comm proposal",4, "Present Proposal",5, "Negotiation/Review",6, "Closed Won",7, 0) <> 1) )
